notes.title: Minagoroshi On Sale Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Order Minagoroshi now and get 10% off during launch week!![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034940/Higurashi_When_They_Cry_Hou__Ch7_Minagoroshi/

At long last, you can enjoy the sixth chapter of this exciting Visual Novel that spawned the highly-acclaimed Higurashi anime and manga series on Steam for the very first time! With updated sprites and other visuals, fans won't want to miss this new release!

In this chapter, Minagoroshi, Keiichi manages to make the choice that would avert the tragedies of Watanagashi and Meakashi. With this revelation that Keiichi and the others are beginning to learn from the events of prior chapters, Rika finally gains hope that there might be a way to end this relentless cycle. Yet those hopes are soon stifled with the arrival of Houjou Teppei, Satoko's abusive uncle. Can the club members avert the tragedy of Tatarigoroshi this time around? Will a different chain of events finally reveal the mastermind behind the tragedies of Hinamizawa? And also... who is the mysterious figure Rika seems to be talking to this time around?

The Answer Arcs continue, and revelations await. So keep your eyes open and don't miss out!

Don't forget to check out our 07th Expansion page either:

http://www.mangagamer.org/07thExpansion/

Help spread the word on twitter with #Higurashi and introduce new fans to this remastered version of such a great series from 07th Expansion!

notes.title: Umineko When They Cry Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Umineko When They Cry (Question Arcs) Now Available![/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/406550

Fans of Higurashi When They Cry won't want to miss this amazing new tale from the same creators at 07th Expansion!

Join Battler, a scion of the wealthy Ushiromiya family, as he attends their annual reunion on the island of Rokkenjima for the first time in six years. However, that night, a disaster falls upon the Ushiromiya family, and they all begin to fear for their very lives. Battler's cousin Maria believes the golden witch Beatrice has returned and committed murder through magic, but Battler doesn't believe in such a fantasy. Still, could anyone in his family really have killed their own kin for the sake of riches? You know both the situation leading up to the incident and its tragic result, but the course of events is an enigma, and no one willing to share the whole truth. What really happened on Rokkenjima that night?

Don't forget to check out our 07th Expansion page either: 

http://www.mangagamer.org/07thExpansion/ 

Help spread the word on twitter with #Umineko and introduce new fans to this remastered version of such a great series from 07th Expansion!

notes.title: Onikakushi Version 1.09 Update
notes.content:
We've recently pushed out an update for Higurashi, which will address some of the issues people have brought up on the Steam forums. You can read the comprehensive list of changes below.

[h1]1.09 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The game will now scale down content to fit the screen when using full screen resolutions where content would normally have been cut off on the left and right side.
[*]If the game window is too small at launch, it will automatically resize to a usable resolution.
[*]Tweaked the screen shake effect to be a bit smoother.
[/list]
[h1]1.08 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the chapter preview screen after clicking start game.
[*]Updated drawing code used on mac and linux releases. Characters should no longer sometimes appear blury.
[*]The engine is now set to pick the optimal rendering engine for your system rather than defaulting to DirectX 9 (on windows).
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]Scripts in the 'Scripts' folder no longer automatically recompile. If you're making changes, please use the 'Update' folder to have scripts automatically recompile.
[/list]
[h1]1.07 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Additional typo fixes.
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]Added support for changing aspect ratio.
[*]Added support for moving the main UI.
[*]Added support for specifying name tags (see init.txt and test.txt for usage).
[/list]
[h1]1.06 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed negative screen transition occurring abnormally slow.
[*]Corrected an issue where you could cancel out of dialogs by right clicking even after hitting yes, causing the game to possibly break in horrifying ways.
[*]Fixed the same kind of issue on the save/load screen.
[*]The "Are you sure you want to load" dialog now shows the correct language for the text preview rather than always English.
[*]Fixed a few more text issues.
[/list]
[h1]1.05 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some typos.
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a Chinese compatible font, set fontid to 3 in init.txt to use.
[*]The game should be a bit smarter about what scripts to recompile.
[/list]
[h1]1.04 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]To prevent some funny business from going on, you can no longer save while viewing tips.
[*]When returning from viewing tips, saving your game on the chapter screen will no longer cause you to return to the last line of the tip you viewed when you load. It should also have the correct save title.
[*]Attempting to save your game immediately after loading your game no longer causes unpredictable behaviour.
[*]When loading a game, returning to the title screen, or finish reading a tip, auto mode and skip mode will automatically cancel.
[*]The game will automatically recompile scripts in the update folder after a game update.
[*]Fixed some missing Japanese kanji that weren't present in font that appears in the after-scenario review party.
[*]Fixed some typos.
[/list]
[h1]1.03 Update[/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a script/text desync issue in the festival scene.
[*]Fixed a bug in which save file names would show up in the wrong language when saving at the end of a chapter.
[*]Corrected one of the 'tips obtained' images being incorrect due to a recent correction.
[/list]
[h1]1.02 Update[/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Press the 'P' key to swap between the original and new sprites. Note that to prevent bizarre bugs, you can only do this while the game is waiting for input.
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]Init.txt and Flow.txt are now provided so you can make changes. 
[*]Init.txt also has some new tools that were added to allow for easier control over the text window.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]A few more typo and consistency fixes.
[*]The text shader was incorrectly targeting shader 3.0, which may have made some systems unable to see text properly.
[/list]
[h1]1.01 Update[/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added additional hotkeys. You can advance text using return, right arrow, page down, or the number pad enter button. The backlog can be brought up using left arrow or page up. You can turn on auto mode using the 'A' key, skip mode using the 'S' key, and toggle full-screen with the 'F' key. Also added keyboard shortcuts on several other screens.
[*]You can now use the 'L' key to switch between English and Japanese text display at any time.
[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*]To assist modders, Cyrillic language characters were added to the game font.
[*]An 'update' folder was added to the StreamingAssets directory. For those interested in modding or making changes to the script files, placing scripts in this folder will take priority over those in the Scripts folder and will not be overwritten when we push out game updates.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]A wide variety of typos and grammatical errors have been fixed.
[*]Fixed the incorrect background music playing when accessing the tips screen.
[*]The tips screen will return to the previously viewed page when returning.
[*]Fixed the beta (β) character not being displayed correctly in the Japanese script.
[*]Fixed a bug where when advancing rapidly multiple frames in a row, the game may not properly clear the 'wait for text' state, causing the caret to be incorrectly visible while the text hasn't finished typing yet. 
[*]Fixed an issue where titles from saved games were being loaded before the selected language was being loaded, causing them to always show in English regardless of the specified language.
[*]Fixed an issue where the black bars would fail to completely cover the out of bounds area when the full-screen resolution is sufficiently large.
[*]Fixed the settings option for 'allow skip unread text' being written incorrectly in Japanese.
[*]Fixed a bug where the new sprites would always be shown for the tips images regardless of which sprites you had selected to use.
[*]Added the ability to swap languages without going to the settings menu by simply hitting the L key.
[*]Fixed a bug where save games would not show the Japanese name if they were saved while playing in English.
[*]Fixed a bug where switching languages after loading a save game would cause some previous text to no longer be visible.
[/list]

The game will automatically recompile scripts in the update folder after a game update.
Fixed some missing Japanese kanji that weren't present in font that appears in the after-scenario review party.
Fixed some typos.
Fixed a script/text desync issue in the festival scene.
Fixed a bug in which save file names would show up in the wrong language when saving at the end of a chapter.
Corrected one of the 'tips obtained' images being incorrect due to a recent correction.

tags.feature: Press the 'P' key to swap between the original and new sprites. Note that to prevent bizarre bugs, you can only do this while the game is waiting for input.
Init.txt and Flow.txt are now provided so you can make changes.
Init.txt also has some new tools that were added to allow for easier control over the text window.

tags.bug: A few more typo and consistency fixes.
The text shader was incorrectly targeting shader 3.0, which may have made some systems unable to see text properly.

tags.feature: Added additional hotkeys. You can advance text using return, right arrow, page down, or the number pad enter button. The backlog can be brought up using left arrow or page up. You can turn on auto mode using the 'A' key, skip mode using the 'S' key, and toggle full-screen with the 'F' key. Also added keyboard shortcuts on several other screens.
You can now use the 'L' key to switch between English and Japanese text display at any time.
To assist modders, Cyrillic language characters were added to the game font.

An 'update' folder was added to the StreamingAssets directory. For those interested in modding or making changes to the script files, placing scripts in this folder will take priority over those in the Scripts folder and will not be overwritten when we push out game updates.

tags.bug: A wide variety of typos and grammatical errors have been fixed.
Fixed the incorrect background music playing when accessing the tips screen.
The tips screen will return to the previously viewed page when returning.
Fixed the beta (β) character not being displayed correctly in the Japanese script.

Fixed a bug where when advancing rapidly multiple frames in a row, the game may not properly clear the 'wait for text' state, causing the caret to be incorrectly visible while the text hasn't finished typing yet.
Fixed an issue where titles from saved games were being loaded before the selected language was being loaded, causing them to always show in English regardless of the specified language.
Fixed an issue where the black bars would fail to completely cover the out of bounds area when the full-screen resolution is sufficiently large.
Fixed the settings option for 'allow skip unread text' being written incorrectly in Japanese.
Fixed a bug where the new sprites would always be shown for the tips images regardless of which sprites you had selected to use.

tags.feature: Added the ability to swap languages without going to the settings menu by simply hitting the L key.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where save games would not show the Japanese name if they were saved while playing in English.
Fixed a bug where switching languages after loading a save game would cause some previous text to no longer be visible.
